tracks.title: Who Do You Think You're Fooling
Here I Am, I Always Am

verdict.detail: The same year as the first issue (US, SP 12510, 1984).

notes.text:
Despite the 'Stereo' on labels the back cover reads:
"This record is Monophonic to reproduce the original quality of these recordings".

B2 track: First official release of this track.
The other 4 are from 2 singles, A & B-sides respectively.

The generic cover has dual codes on back for UK & Europe, which were suitably 'over-stickered' to blank-out either code for marketing/distribution. However, the label cat#s are printed for respective market.

Back cover;
℗ © 1984 A&M Records Inc.
"Made in Holland"
"Distribution CBS Records/CBS Disques SA"

Mastered at A&M Mastering Studios, Hollywood, CA.
(Master cut at Tape One, London).
